title: django-project-template
subtitle: Full-Featured Django Template
description: A Django starter with PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT, social login, Channels and django-q2. The setup I kept repeating, now tested end to end.
longDescription: A Docker Compose backend template with Django, PostgreSQL and Redis. It combines JWT and Google/Microsoft login, Channels WebSockets and django-q2 background tasks, configured from environment variables and checked end to end in CI.
features: JWT with Google and Microsoft login
PostgreSQL and Redis in Docker Compose
results: Reusable backend template with an end-to-end verification workflow
